scenes.vo: What if someone tries to turn your protection off? With Zero Write, standard users cannot change the agent's files. Only an admin, or the portal, can lower protection.
scenes.caption: What if someone tries to turn your protection off? With ZeroWrite, standard users cannot change the agent's files. Only an admin, or the portal, can lower protection.

scenes.chapter: You decide, it's on the record
scenes.vo: When a file is held, you decide. Allow it, restore it if the verdict was wrong, or delete it. Every decision is kept in a local history, so it can always be traced.
scenes.caption: When a file is held, you decide. Allow it, restore it if the verdict was wrong, or delete it. Every decision is kept in a local history, so it can always be traced.

scenes.vo: If a machine holds a threat, isolate it in one step. It is cut off from everything except Zero Write, so it can still be managed, and released once it is clean.
scenes.caption: If a machine holds a threat, isolate it in one step. It is cut off from everything except ZeroWrite.ai, so it can still be managed, and released once it is clean.

scenes.vo: Losing the network never lowers protection. And an expired subscription never disables it. The updates stop, but the protection does not.
scenes.caption: Losing the network never lowers protection. And an expired subscription never disables it. Updates stop. Protection does not.
